source: Finite complex weighted channel packets with integer coordinates, positive rational mesh, supplied mark, immutable geometric seed records and per-contribution lineage.
query_class: Finite complex linear combinations of tensor Gaussians c exp(pi L - pi sum A_i x_i^2 + 2 pi sum B_i x_i), A_i positive rational and B_i complex rational; exact symbolic output.

representations.packet: Full contribution list; axis/off-axis partition derived with the current mark, never discarded.
representations.history: Frozen packet snapshot plus ordered analytic word; queries evaluated by reversed transpose transport. No claim that the current state is still a finite packet after Fourier.

operations.axis_shift: existing_pointed_channel_license; move every contribution, including off-axis terms
operations.modulation: existing_pointed_channel_license; multiply every contribution weight by its full-coordinate character
operations.heat: existing_pointed_channel_license; multiply every contribution by exp(-pi t h^2 ||n||^2), t>=0
operations.axis_convolution: existing_pointed_channel_license; branch every contribution over the finite axis kernel, retaining parent lineage
operations.dyadic_bond: existing_pointed_channel_license; n -> 2n and h -> h/2; physical positions and weights unchanged
operations.relabel: existing_pointed_channel_license; permute all coordinates and transport the mark; do not infer polygon geometry from arbitrary permutations
operations.fourier: declared_analytic_history_extension; append full additive Fourier operation, use bilinear transpose F on tests; not a native twelve-arrow clock admission

unsupported: queries from twelve-arrow coordinates alone about an unspecified geometric packet
arbitrary Schwartz test evaluators without a supplied executable evaluator
infinite packet sums or arbitrary tempered-state access without a separate certified oracle
off-axis translations under the existing axis-only license
arbitrary whole-source binary convolution through the selected reader
packet-only updates after entering Fourier history without an explicit representation conversion
restoring discarded archives or fabricating missing geometric lineage
archive_policy: Retain immutable seed geometry and ordered operation records. Current weighted/transformed terms are not asserted to be new triangulations. Original geometry is provenance, not a freshly inferred geometric realization.
twelve_arrow_binding: Unmatched: no common geometric seed constructor supplied. Existing K=JP and Nx do not encode the channel off-axis packet.
